runs.name: Bouygues SA
runs.entry: The second name on the operator's sheet with no SEC filings. Price **EUR 40.30** per Paris share (EN.PA, Euronext Paris, close 2026-10-09, aggregator, flagged; the OTC line BOUYF closed USD 43.90 the same day, thinly traded) x **387,402,574 shares** (388,438,129 in issue at 2026-09-30, release of 2026-10-01, less 1,035,555 treasury at 2025-12-31, URD 2025 note 5.3; `cover_shares.py` and `run.py` not run, both read SEC filings) = cap **EUR 15,612M**; sovereign **3.778%** (ECB euro-area AAA 30-year spot, 2026-10-08). Primary documents the 2025 Universal Registration Document (AMF, filed 2026-03-19), read in the filed French text from the AMF because bouygues.com refused scripted requests (translations the analyst's own), the earlier registration documents, and the company's half-year release of 2026-07-30 in place of the interim report; AMF filing numbers and URLs recorded in place of accessions. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the URD's business description, risk factors (4.1.3 telecoms, 4.1.4 media) and segment note, as the overnight brief directs. Q1 IN by its deciding part: no part earns half of 2021-2025 current operating profit, so the largest, Bouygues Telecom at 30.4%, decides under Q2's parts convention; its variables (operators, price per subscriber, subscribers, capital spending) filed back to 2013, and the insiders put a ten-year forecast on paper (the 2026-06-06 SFR memorandum: synergies about EUR 1bn a year in full by 2034). **Q2 OUT:** the attacker with money came and was able (Free's entry in 2012; Bouygues Telecom's operating profit EUR 125M in 2013 to EUR (65)M in 2014); Bouygues Telecom the high-cost operator in a field sold on price (mobile revenue per customer down EUR 0.7 a month in 2025 and EUR 0.6 more by Q2 2026; the URD names the price pressure a risk); its own goodwill test breaks even at a 6.0% discount rate (URD 2025 note 3.2.4); the field's returns ordinary over the cycle since 2012 (SFR's owner through a creditor restructuring in 2025; Orange France about 8.4% before tax on segment assets in 2024). The SFR consolidation (memorandum 2026-06-06, EUR 20.35bn enterprise value, about EUR 8.5bn Bouygues Telecom's, debt-financed; definitive documents not announced by 2026-10-12; closing targeted for the second half of 2027) not credited: not happened, and a change for the better is credited only on a full cycle. Q3 to Q12 not reached. **COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE:** owner cash (group share, all-equity, EUR M) 728, 593, 1,106, 1,397, 1,730 for 2021-2025, never above 3.0% of sales; base 2023-2025, the three full years after the Equans purchase (2022, EUR 6.27bn), the analyst's confessed CONVENTION because Equans's pre-merger figures are not in the buyer's filings; growth cut to sales growth 0.76%, so the range inverts (no-growth case the top). Range **EUR 76.73-79.58** all-equity at the sovereign on June 2026 net debt EUR 6,515M (equity-only 82.75-86.28; on December 2025 net debt EUR 4,204M, 82.70-85.55); literal 2021-2025 window EUR (21.79), negative; fair **EUR 17.09** all-equity (equity-only 29.98; 23.05 on December net debt; 39.34 with working-capital releases counted as permanent); no case earns the floor at the price (6.38% and 4.46%); the SFR deal on the filed record would lower the fair price by about EUR 14 a share before synergy. Balance sheets 2016-2025 read in Step 0: goodwill and intangibles 93% of group equity rising to 133% after Equans, stated tangible equity negative; net debt EUR 0.9bn (2021) to 7.4bn (2022) to 4.2bn (2025); customer advances EUR 4.1bn (2020) to 9.5bn (2025), the EUR 2.9bn released over 2023-2025 reversing if volumes fall. Competitors named in the URD, read from their own filings: EBITDA after leases less capital spending as a share of sales, Bouygues Telecom 6.9% (2025) against Iliad France 20.8% (H1 2025, a trade-site copy, flagged), Orange France 19.2% (2025), SFR 16.1% (2025); 2020 operating margin Bouygues Telecom 9.7% against Iliad France 18.5%; Orange France's segment for 2012-2022 and Iliad's FY2025 report not obtained. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: the EUR 308M Free Mobile judgment against Bouygues Telecom, Free's claim on appeal EUR 805M to 1,440M; final damages in the Ile-de-France schools cartel case; suspicious payments at Colas Rail on contracts from 2011, new developments in October 2025; a contested EUR 100M tax reassessment; stock options created 7.75M shares in 2025 beside buybacks. Could not get: the English URD, the half-year 2026 report itself, the Free Mobile appeal's outcome; the governance and pay chapter not read. Analyst's framework gaps for the operator: (1) the parts convention let a 30% part decide the box while 70% of profit went unjudged; (2) the merger rule cannot be applied when the target's own figures are not filed by the buyer; (3) net debt at the latest filed date is seasonal here (June against December moves the fair price about EUR 6); (4) minority interests are not mentioned in the all-equity convention (TF1 is 47% owned); (5) specific (d) speaks of working-capital increases only, not releases; (6) Q2 has no rule for a structural change signed but not closed; (7) the template assumes SEC documents; (8) the template's headings carry dashes. **Dispatcher's note:** no fair alert armed (box not OUT at Q7), so the euro gap met at ADRZY does not arise. Contamination declared by the analyst: a filtered listing of `Test Runs/` showing today's ADRZY and SUNB run names, the session context's SUNB commit subjects, and the memory index's queue lines; none about this company, none opened or used. Four commits (8acaf5d6 to 0e747667), the file closing at Q2. Citations: the analyst's check 49 ids, 16 fragments, 0 problems; the dispatcher's script (`fold_cite_check.py`) 33 bracketed ids present, 12 fragments, 0 slips. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT at EUR 40.30 (Paris): no part earns half the profit, so Bouygues Telecom (30.4% of 2021-2025 operating profit) decides, the high-cost operator in a four-network field sold on price since Free's entry in 2012, its own goodwill test breaking even at 6.0%; the SFR consolidation signed 2026-06-06 and not closed is not credited. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range EUR 76.73-79.58 all-equity on a 2023-2025 post-Equans base, fair EUR 17.09 (not armed, box not OUT at Q7). The analyst asks whether a part with under a third of the profit should carry a conglomerate's box.
